description: Find out who wins US federal contracts and grants, or what a company has been awarded. Searches USAspending.gov (official US Treasury data) across contracts, IDVs, grants or loans by keyword, recipient, awarding agency, NAICS and date range: award ID, recipient, UEI, amount, agency, dates, description, place of performance and links. Use for competitor research, partner finding or US public-sector sales leads. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: search_us_federal_awards
